text:
alice: quick heads-up — i pushed a draft grafana dashboard for microbatch sampling + kernel-selection observability. link: https://grafana/redwood/d/microbatch-sampling (draft)

ben: :eyes: nice. what's the root metric set? batch sizes / wait / kernel count? any token-level breakdowns?

alice: started with these panels: batch_size histogram, queue_wait p50/p95/p99, kernel_choice split (counts per kernel), and token_latency waterfall (per-token percentile by kernel). also a per-route KPI row.

carla: can you paste the promql for token waterfall? we need to compare before/after the scheduler change.

alice: sure — here's the current token_latency panel query (draft):
```
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(redwood_token_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route, kernel))
```
and batch size histogram:
```
sum(rate(redwood_batch_size_bucket[5m])) by (le, route)
```

diego: I noticed low kvcache hit ratio on /chat-stream route during yesterday's canary. suspect sampler is sending cold prefixes that miss the KV. we need a route-level kv_cache_hit metric.

marta: current 99th token SLO is 220ms. the dashboard shows p99 token latency for some routes at ~320ms after kernel switch to quantized-ff. that's a regression we should triage before rollout.

ben: we should instrument sampler efficiency: fraction of batches with >1 token concat (i.e. real batching) vs single-request batches. metric idea: redwood_sampler_efficiency{route}

carla: +1 on per-route kv cache hit. also add per-route avg missed_kv_bytes to spot large context misses.

alice: proto exporter changes — i'll add these metric names:
- redwood_kv_cache_hits_total{route,zone}
- redwood_kv_cache_misses_total{route,zone}
- redwood_token_latency_seconds_bucket{route,kernel}
- redwood_batch_size_bucket{route}
- redwood_sampler_efficiency_ratio{route}

ben: small nit: make sampler efficiency a gauge 0..1 so we can reliably alert on drops.

diego: for immediate triage, run this query to correlate kernel switches with p99 spikes:
```
join_over_time(
  max by (kernel) (increase(redwood_kernel_switches_total[10m])),
  histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(redwood_token_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route, kernel))
)
```
(not perfect promql but good starting point)

marta: alerting proposals:
- route_token_p99 > 250ms for 5m -> paging pager oncall
- sampler_efficiency_ratio < 0.3 for 10m -> message #eng-runtime
- kv_cache_miss_rate > 0.2 for 10m on high-traffic routes -> investigate

infra-bot: deploy: grafana/dash/microbatch-sampling updated by alice — diff: +6 panels, +3 queries

alice: next steps:
1) i'll open a small PR to exporter with those metric names (assign to me)
2) bench team (ben) will add a synthetic workload to repro low kv hit + kernel switch
3) carla to add prometheus queries + panels for histogram delta and per-route waterfall
4) diego to run a short canary with sampler config variant "microbatch-2s" and post logs

ben: i'll try to repro on staging today. if i see >2x p99 increase i'll drop canary.

carla: i'll mock dashboards and add a panel comparing "kernel_selector.version" tag on the token waterfall.

diego: one quick debug snippet for logs if we need it:
```
# sample logs filter
rg "kernel=quantized-ff" logs/staging/* | tail -n 200
```

marta: can we add a small note in the dashboard header with recommended guardrails? eg "if route p99 > SLO after kernel change, revert to fallback kernel and open incident".

alice: good call. i'll add header + a runbook link.

ben: :+1: when the PR is up post link here and i'll review.

alice: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/metrics/pull/487 (WIP). tagging reviewers @ben @carla

carla: :thinking: also consider adding a sampling-age metric so we can see how long requests wait before batch formation — might explain kv cache coldness.

diego: agreed. redwood_batch_wait_seconds_bucket{route,node} would help.

alice: awesome. i'll add wait histogram to the PR as well.

marta: timeline ask from product: can we have a production-safe dashboard + alerting by end of this week? if exporter PR is small we can ship.

alice: optimistic: PR today, staging canary tomorrow, prod dashboard + alerts by Thu/Fri.

ben: i'll block time tomorrow morning.

alice: thanks everyone. leaving this thread open for updates. :shipit:
